source: tool schemas visible to a Claude Code session on the author's account, 2026-11-14; copied from evals/mocks/connectors by the converter session, only the tools references/tool-maps.json uses
note: Input schemas only: no output schema was captured, so result adapters that depend on a tool output are unverified.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Reads messages from a Slack channel in reverse chronological order (newest first). To read DM history, use a user_id as channel_id. Read-only. Use slack_read_thread with message_ts to read thread replies. Use slack_search_channels to find a channel ID by name. Use slack_search_public to search ac...

channel_id.description: ID of the Channel, private group, or IM channel to fetch history for. Can also be a user_id to read DM history.

limit.description: Number of messages to return, between 1 and 100. Default value is 100.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections of data by setting the cursor parameter to a next_cursor attribute returned by a previous request

latest.description: End of time range of messages to include in results (timestamp)

oldest.description: Start of time range of messages to include in results (timestamp)

response_format.description: Level of detail: 'detailed' (default, includes reactions + thread info) or 'concise'.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Reads messages from a specific Slack thread (parent message + all replies). Read-only. Requires channel_id and message_ts of the parent message. Use slack_search_public or slack_read_channel to find these values. Use slack_search_public with "is:thread" to find threads by content. Use slack_send_...

channel_id.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel to fetch thread replies for

message_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message (e.g. "1234567890.123456"). Must be a string in Slack ts format with a decimal point.

limit.description: Number of messages to return, between 1 and 1000. Default value is 100.

cursor.description: Paginate through collections of data by setting the cursor parameter to a next_cursor attribute returned by a previous request

latest.description: End of time range of messages to include in results. Slack ts format string (e.g. "1234567890.123456").

oldest.description: Start of time range of messages to include in results. Slack ts format string (e.g. "1234567890.123456").

response_format.description: Level of detail: 'detailed' (default, includes reactions + thread info) or 'concise'.

tools.name: slack_read_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieves detailed profile information for a Slack user: contact info, status, timezone, organization, and role. Read-only. Defaults to current user if user_id not provided. Use slack_search_users to find a user ID by name or email.

user_id.description: Slack user ID to look up (e.g., 'U0ABC12345'). Defaults to current user if not provided

include_locale.description: Include user's locale information. Default: false

response_format.description: Level of detail in response. 'detailed' includes all fields, 'concise' shows essential info. Default: detailed'

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel or user. To DM a user, use their user_id as channel_id. If the user wants to send a message to themselves, the current logged in user's user_id is U_REDACTED. Return the message link to the user. Message uses standard markdown (**bold**, _italic_, `code`, ~~str...

thread_ts.description: Provide another message’s ts value to make this message a reply

draft_id.description: ID of the draft to delete after sending

unfurl_app_links.description: Set to true to enable link previews from installed apps (e.g. GitHub, Jira) in the message
